products.name: JusT Insight
products.line: What happened on your site, and why, in plain words.
products.line_hr: Što se dogodilo na vašoj stranici i zašto, jednostavnim riječima.
points: Every page opens on what happened, in plain words, before any chart.
Every figure shows what it rests on
Its period, what it is compared with, and where it comes from, one tap away.
What is not set up or not measured yet says so, instead of showing a zero.

products.name: JusT Content
products.line: Change your site yourself, in its own look, without breaking it.
products.line_hr: Sami uređujete svoju stranicu, u njezinu stilu, a da je ne pokvarite.
points: You change the real pages, in the styles your site already has.
What your site’s design does not allow is locked, so a change cannot break it.

products.name: JusT Ops
products.line: Your site up, renewed and backed up, checked every night.
products.line_hr: Stranica radi, obnovljena je i ima sigurnosnu kopiju, a provjeravamo je svake noći.
points: Every night: is the site up, is its certificate renewed, how old is its backup.
The certificate is renewed before it expires, not after.
A recent backup, and its age, on the console.
